why: The prose, code stripped, discloses the solution. NOTE what is NOT in this corpus: a `leak.is_solution` case would have to carry a working solution to a shipped Belay exercise, i.e. an answer key, in a repository whose whole purpose is to be published. Belay's own suite covers that path (tests/test_verifier_contract_leak.py), including the both-signals precedence case. Publishing the answer key to prove a verifier withholds answer keys is the joke SPEC.md section 6 is trying to prevent.
